email.body1:
Christopher, saw Alkira post 1,261% three-year growth and launch the Connect Partner Program off the back of it.

Growth that steep usually means more accounts in your AZ-NV-UT-CO territory are in-market than you can personally cover, and that is exactly where good deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new hires: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Alkira off your growth and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Christopher, quick follow-up for Alkira.

With growth and a new partner program both pulling on pipeline, more accounts are in-market across your region than the team can touch. Most reps do not know how many meetings they actually need to book to hit quota, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your territory needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Christopher, last bit of proof for Alkira.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Alkira's reply rate likely compares to other high-growth infrastructure startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Christopher, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling territory pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Riding triple-digit growth is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a regional-sales motion? I will tailor it to Alkira either way.
